products.name: On Purpose Crewneck
products.description: Heavyweight crewneck with "on purpose" embroidered small at the left cuff. Garment-dyed, so it feels worn in on day one. This is the sweatshirt I made first, for myself.
details: Tonal "on purpose" embroidery at the left cuff
Relaxed fit, dropped shoulder. Size down for a closer fit

images.alt: On Purpose Crewneck in bone, on a bone studio backdrop
Close view of a bone sweatshirt cuff with small on purpose embroidery

products.name: Intentional Hoodie
products.description: Heavyweight hoodie with a small serif "intentional" across the chest. Double-layer hood, flat drawcords, a plain kangaroo pocket. The one I wear on early mornings.
details: Double-layer hood, flat cotton drawcords with matte metal tips

images.alt: Intentional Hoodie in oat, on a bone studio backdrop
Person wearing the oat Intentional Hoodie, hands in the pocket

products.name: IT Monogram Crewneck
products.description: Midweight crewneck with a tiny italic "IT" at the chest. Regular fit. Fine under a coat, or on its own.
details: Side seams, so the front stays clean

images.alt: IT Monogram Crewneck in espresso, on a bone studio backdrop

products.name: Daily Practice Tee
products.description: Boxy tee in dense organic jersey. "daily practice" is printed small at the back neck. It keeps its shape after washing.
details: Water-based "daily practice" print at the back neck

images.alt: Daily Practice Tee in bone, on a bone studio backdrop

products.name: First Light Crewneck
products.description: Limited crewneck in garment-dyed Quiet Sage, with "begin again" stitched in cream along the hem. We made 300. The dye varies a little from piece to piece.
details: Cream "begin again" embroidery at the front hem
Garment-dyed Quiet Sage. Each piece varies slightly

products.name: Slow Morning Zip Hoodie
products.description: Full-zip hoodie in oat, with a brushed-brass zip and a small sage "slow mornings" at the chest. Relaxed fit, true to size.

images.alt: Slow Morning Zip Hoodie in oat, on a bone studio backdrop

products.name: Decide Tee
products.description: Cream tee with one word on the chest: "decide." Printed in sage. The simplest thing in the shop.

products.name: North Star Signet Ring
products.description: A rounded signet with a small four-point star on the face. "on purpose" is hand-engraved inside the band. The face is a 9mm oval. Made to wear every day.
details: 14k gold vermeil over recycled sterling silver
Hand-engraved star on the face. "on purpose" inside the band
Face is a 9mm oval. The band tapers to 2mm
US sizes 4 to 11. Half sizes are available
Inside-band personalization is free, up to 20 characters

products.name: Compass Pendant Necklace
products.description: A small round medallion with a compass star, on a fine cable chain. The back is left blank for a word, a goal, or a date.
details: 14k gold vermeil over recycled sterling silver
Optional back engraving, up to 12 characters

products.name: On Purpose Bar Necklace
